proof_summary: For the candidate linear-recurrence sequence, introduce the Cassini-type determinant \(\delta_n=L_{n+1}^2-L_{n+2}L_n\); its recurrence \(\delta_{n+3}=4\delta_{n+1}+\delta_n\), together with the growth bound \(L_{n+1}\ge 3L_n\), yields \(0<\delta_n\le L_n\) by induction. These bounds force \(\lceil L_{n+1}^2/L_n\rceil-1=L_{n+2}\), so equality of the initial terms and induction identify the original nonlinear sequence with the linear one.
